proposals.before: Ten prefectures including Suai, Gui, Song, Rao, Ning, Hai, Rui, Yu, Tieli, and Fengde were abolished, along with eight counties including Yutian, Liaofeng, Songshan, Hongyuan, Huaiqing, Yunlong, Pingze, and Pingshan; their populations were reassigned to other jurisdictions.
proposals.after: Ten prefectures including Sui, Gui, Song, Rao, Ning, Hai, Rui, Yu, Tieli, and Fengde were abolished, along with eight counties including Yutian, Liaofeng, Songshan, Hongyuan, Huaiqing, Yunlong, Pingze, and Pingshan; their populations were reassigned to other jurisdictions.

proposals.after: On dingchou day Dingnan Army military commissioner Li Jipeng submitted; he was granted the titles Loyal and Obedient, Effectively Obedient, Initiating Sage, and Pacifier of Dingnan, made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and acting grand preceptor with concurrent palace secretary, and enfeoffed as Western Peace King.

decisions.reason: 封漆水郡王 is a 郡王 (commandery prince), so Duke is wrong; but 上京留守 is also not a military commissioner (節度使). The proposal fixes only 郡王; the full correction must render 留守 as Shangjing regent.

decisions.reason: 給事中 is the Supervising Secretary, a Menxia consulting office, not a censorate post. Supervisory censor invents 御史 sense; Supervising Secretary matches 給事中.
為中京留守 names the capital stay-behind office 留守, not 節度使. Zhongjing military commissioner is a title error; Zhongjing regent matches the Chinese office.
The literal likewise misrenders 中京留守 as military commissioner; Zhongjing regent correctly reflects 留守.
以翰林承旨邢抱樸 names the office 翰林承旨; English that stops at Hanlin Academician omits 承旨 (Recipient of Edicts). The proposed expansion restores the full title.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以翰林承旨邢抱樸參知政事

decisions.reason: Literal likewise omits 承旨 from 翰林承旨; adding Recipient of Edicts restores the Chinese office designation.
封蘭陵郡王 confers a 郡王 rank (wang), not a dukedom (公). Duke under-translates the title; Commandery Prince of Lanling matches 蘭陵郡王.
Literal likewise calls 蘭陵郡王 a Duke; Commandery Prince of Lanling correctly renders the 郡王 enfeoffment.
癸未 is the sexagenary day guiwei; guimao would require 癸卯. The proposed guiwei matches the Chinese day name.
Literal likewise misreads 癸未 as guimao; guiwei is the correct reading of 未, not 卯.
韓德凝 is Han Dening (德凝); Ningning invents a reading unsupported by 德凝. The proposed personal name restores the Chinese characters.
Literal likewise has Han Ningning for 韓德凝; Han Dening is the correct transliteration.
